Negative Feedback / Risk Areas

 Frequent customer complaints about premature pump failures and poor reliability.
 Problems with check valves and pump heads failing within months.

Positive Feedback

Some customers found Shurflo helpful in finding correct replacement parts and local retailers and value product availability when units work.
